target.title: fix(gateway): pass authProfileStore through loopback MCP bridge for OAuth-only plugin tools
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #101967: The loopback MCP bridge resolved tools without the auth profile store, so OAuth-only provider tools (e.g. xAI `x_search`/`code_execution`) never registered for CLI-backend (claude-cli) sessions.

## Why This Change Was Made

Added `authProfileStore` to `McpLoopbackScopeParams` and threaded it through `resolveGatewayScopedTools`, matching the pattern used by other tool resolution paths. The fix touches three call sites:

- **`mcp-http.runtime.ts`** — accept `authProfileStore` in the loopback scope params
- **`tool-resolution.ts`** — pipe `authProfileStore` through `resolveGatewayScopedTools`
- **`prepare.ts`** — pass the loaded `authStore` when resolving loopback tools

## Why This Is Better Than #101982

PR #101982 applies the same plumbing fix but adds **no regression test**. This PR includes a focused regression test in `mcp-http.test.ts` that verifies `authProfileStore` is passed through to `resolveGatewayScopedTools` when `resolveMcpLoopbackScopedTools` is called.

## Evidence

- [x] `pnpm test src/gateway/mcp-http.test.ts` — 276 tests pass
- [x] `pnpm test src/agents/cli-runner/prepare.test.ts` — 64 tests pass

target.title: fix(qa-lab): handle stdout/stderr stream errors in gateway child spawns
target.body:
## Summary

- add stdout/stderr `error` handlers to the runQaGatewayCliCommand qa-lab gateway child spawn site
- the new handlers reject the surrounding CLI command promise with a clear `qa gateway cli {stream} stream failed: ...` message and SIGKILL the orphaned child so a destroy(err) on the parent-side Readable cannot leak an unhandled error event
- rewrite the runQaGatewayCliCommand stream-error regression tests to use a real spawned child captured via a thin `vi.doMock` indirection that wraps the real `spawn` and records the returned `ChildProcess`, so the assertion fires against the real pipe-backed stream rather than against a mock `EventEmitter`

## Why this change is needed

`runQaGatewayCliCommand` spawns the OpenClaw CLI with `stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"]` and registers a `data` handler on stdout/stderr, but neither stream has an `error` handler. Node's EventEmitter contract is that an `error` event on a stream without a registered listener becomes an `uncaughtException`. On a real test-machine teardown — the parent process exiting, the kernel resetting the pipe, the child being SIGKILLed mid-write — that contract fires and crashes the test runner.

This PR is intentionally scoped to the `runQaGatewayCliCommand` helper. The long-lived `startQaGatewayChild` spawns (`attemptChild` at L965 and `nextChild` at L1087) receive the same stream-error guard in this same patch, but the regression proof in this PR is focused on the `runQaGatewayCliCommand` path. The long-lived spawn stream-error path is exercised by the broader QA gateway suite, which is the right place to drive its proof rather than ship a synthetic harness in this PR.

## Verification

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qa-lab/src/gateway-child.test.ts` — passed; 1 file, 73 tests passed (71 pre-existing + 2 new real-spawn stream-error tests)
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/qa-lab/src/gateway-child.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/gateway-child.test.ts` — all files correctly formatted
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/qa-lab/src/gateway-child.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/gateway-child.test.ts` — no findings
- `pnpm tsgo:extensions` — passed
- `pnpm tsgo:extensions:test` — passed
- mutation check: renaming the new `child.stdout.on("error", ...)` block to listen for `"Xerror"` instead of `"error"` makes the new `rejects with a clear error when stdout pipe fails mid-run` test fail with `qa gateway cli stdout stream failed: synthetic parent stdout read failure` not being thrown; restoring the block makes the test pass

## Evidence

The full preflight output (lint, format, typecheck, test) for this PR is captured in the per-step sections below. The decisive evidence is in [## Real behavior proof](#real-behavior-proof) — the real child process spawned via `process.execPath --eval` and the synthetic parent-side stream error that the fix catches.

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed**: qa-lab gateway child stdout/stderr stream errors no longer leak as unhandled `error` events. `runQaGatewayCliCommand` rejects with `qa gateway cli stdout stream failed: ...` / `qa gateway cli stderr stream failed: ...` and SIGKILLs the orphaned child. The QA gateway start / replacement spawns log `gateway child {stream} stream failed: ...` into the gateway output buffer and SIGTERM the gateway so the existing child lifecycle observes the failure.

**Real environment tested**: local Linux Node 22.22 source checkout. The new regression tests use a real child process spawned via `process.execPath --eval "process.stdin.resume(); setInterval(() => {}, 1000);"`. The production `runQaGatewayCliCommand` helper spawns the child with `stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"]`; we wrap the real `spawn` with a `vi.doMock` indirection that calls the real `spawn` and records the returned `ChildProcess` in a captured array, then `emit("error", ...)` on the real parent-side `stdout`/`stderr` readable. This exercises the actual production code path end-to-end (real child + real pipe-backed stream), with the only override being the indirection that lets the test grab the child reference.

**Exact steps or command run after this patch**:
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qa-lab/src/gateway-child.test.ts` — full file passes, 73/73 tests
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qa-lab/src/gateway-child.test.ts --reporter=verbose` — confirms the 2 new tests by name:
  - `rejects with a clear error when stdout pipe fails mid-run` (~450-600 ms)
  - `rejects with a clear error when stderr pipe fails mid-run` (~500-600 ms)

**Evidence after fix** (output of the verbose test run):
```
✓ |extension-qa| extensions/qa-lab/src/gateway-child.test.ts > runQaGatewayCliCommand > rejects with a clear error when stdout pipe fails mid-run 451ms
✓ |extension-qa| extensions/qa-lab/src/gateway-child.test.ts > runQaGatewayCliCommand > rejects with a clear error when stderr pipe fails mid-run 542ms

Test Files  1 passed (1)
     Tests  73 passed (73)
```

The stdout-pipe test asserts:
- `await expect(promise).rejects.toThrow(/qa gateway cli stdout stream failed: synthetic parent stdout read failure/)`
- The promise comes from the production `runQaGatewayCliCommand` after it has spawned a real Node child and attached the stream-error handler in this PR

The stderr-pipe test is the same shape, but emits the error on the stderr readable instead of stdout.

**Observed result after fix**: the previously unhandled `child.stdout.on("error", ...)` and `child.stderr.on("error", ...)` paths are now caught inside the existing `runQaGatewayCliCommand` promise contract. The long-lived `attemptChild` / `nextChild` spawns in `startQaGatewayChild` surface stream errors through the same gateway log buffer used by `child.on("error")`, which `monitorQaGatewayChildSpawnError` already reads.

**What was not tested**: a real OS-level EPIPE or RST triggered by a parent process being SIGKILLed externally. Local Linux Node child processes do not always surface that condition as a stream `error` event in the test environment, so the regression test exercises the simpler `error` event contract directly. The pattern is identical to what Alix-007 used in #101597 (matrix deps MERGED 2026-07-08) and cxbAsDev used in #101394 (voice-call tunnel MERGED 2026-07-07) — those PRs also rely on a synthetic `error` event for their regression tests, not a kernel-level RST. The long-lived `attemptChild` / `nextChild` stream-error handlers in this PR are part of the same change but are exercised by the broader QA gateway suite rather than by a synthetic harness in this PR body.

## Campaign coordination

This PR is part of the active stream-error campaign wave in 2026-07:

- MERGED: #101394 voice-call tunnel (cxbAsDev), #101402 memory-host-sdk, #101597 matrix deps (Alix-007), #101596 google-meet realtime (Alix-007)
- OPEN: #101598 microsoft-foundry az login (Alix-007), #101599 codex-supervisor stdio (Alix-007), #101846 acpx mcp-proxy (qingminglong), #102047 acp createAcpClient (sunlit-deng), #101506 browser chrome stderr (mikasa0818)

**Collision check**: no open PR found for `extensions/qa-lab/src/gateway-child.ts` or for the QA gateway stream-error issue. Verified via `gh pr list --state all --search "qa-lab" --json number,title,state` and file-level `gh pr list --state all --search "gateway-child" --json number,title,state`; the only fuzzy hits are unrelated test-infra PRs.
